description: Fresh or frozen cherry.
Starchy cooking banana, eaten green or ripe.
Fresh rocket (arugula) leaves, sold as a salad or leaf vegetable rather than a herb.
An undressed mix of salad leaves in which no one leaf makes up half or more of the weight.
Fresh sweet, non-pungent pepper.
Fresh or frozen pungent pepper; its heat is measured.
Fresh avocado, shelved with vegetables because it is not sweet as sold.
Fresh courgette (zucchini), shelved with squash of the same culinary use.
Sprouts and cut microgreens sold to eat.
A mix of berries or small fruit in which no one kind makes up half or more of the weight, such as a forest-fruit mix.
A mix of fruit from several crop groups in which no one kind makes up half or more of the weight, such as a smoothie mix.
A plain mix of vegetables from several crop groups, such as frozen mixed vegetables, in which no one kind makes up half or more of the weight.
Fresh uncured olive; cured table olives are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh or frozen wakame seaweed; dried wakame is in Pantry Staples.
A mix of fruit and vegetables, such as a party tray, in which no one kind makes up half or more of the weight.
Fresh or frozen immature bean pods eaten whole (French, runner, yardlong beans); dried beans are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh morel; dried morels are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh porcini or cep (Boletus edulis group); dried is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh papaya (Carica papaya), ripe or green; green papaya sold to cook is the same fruit.
Fresh longan (Dimocarpus longan); dried longan flesh is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh passion fruit, purple, yellow or sweet granadilla types, including cholupa.
Fresh Annona fruit of any species; species names overlap by region.
Fresh fig; dried figs are in Pantry Staples.
Dates sold as fresh fruit (khalal, rutab, fresh soft dates on the branch or chilled); packed dried dates are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh horseradish root; grated horseradish in jars is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh maca root; dried maca and maca flour are in Pantry Staples, capsules in Health, Medical & Mobility.
Fresh Phaseolus beans sold in or out of the pod to shell; green beans are the pod eaten whole, dried beans are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh artichoke heads; artichoke hearts in jars or tins are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh fennel bulb; fennel seed is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh bamboo shoots; tinned or boiled-packed shoots are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh thyme; dried thyme is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh jackfruit, whole or cut, ripe or young green; tinned jackfruit is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh Ziziphus jujuba fruit; dried red dates are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh wood ear fungus (Auricularia); dried wood ear is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh or frozen dill leaf (Anethum graveolens), sold in bunches or packs; dill seed and dried dill are in Pantry Staples.
Fresh rosemary sprigs (Salvia rosmarinus); dried rosemary is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh sage leaves (Salvia officinalis); dried sage is in Pantry Staples.
Fresh chives (Allium schoenoprasum) sold in bunches or packs as a herb; garlic chives and wild chives are separate.
Fresh swede (Brassica napus var. napobrassica); turnip is separate.
Fresh Chinese cabbage (Brassica rapa, Pekinensis group); ordinary head cabbage is separate.
Fresh Allium fistulosum sold as long white-shanked negi; young salad onions are spring onions.
Fresh or frozen broad beans (Vicia faba), in or out of the pod; dried beans are in Pantry Staples.
